instructions: Keep comments short: one or two sentences plus file:line. Where a rule cites an ADR under docs/adr/, link the ADR instead of restating it. PRs may target a parent branch rather than main (stacked PRs); review only the diff against the PR base. Before flagging a race, missing retry or stale read, check the ADR or code comment at that site: documented best-effort checks and post-commit sends are intentional. If you still disagree, cite the ADR.

rules.rule: HTML from any external source passes through src/util/sanitizeCmsData.ts, the one allowlist; do not add a second sanitizer or rehype-sanitize config.
Every Sentry init passes the shared dataCollection from src/sentryDataCollection.ts, and that baseline is not loosened; the CoC report form must not reach Sentry (docs/adr/0015).
A new external fetch in src/data/ is a defineSource() from src/data/source.ts, which owns the mock gate and the tagged unstable_cache that /_cache revalidates.
src/data/bots.ts is generated from src/data/botOverrides.ts by pnpm build-bot-list and checked in; never hand-edit it.
URL redirects belong in netlify.toml, not next.config.mjs.
Member files export a MemberObject whose github field matches the filename and export identifier (vc/member-file-identity); emoji must be standard Unicode.
dangerouslySetInnerHTML takes only output of sanitizeCmsData (lint rule vc/no-raw-dangerously-set-inner-html).

CONTEXT.md vocabulary governs identifiers, comments, docs and /admin UI. Public copy is exempt: src/app/join/**, src/emails/**, the public form pages, src/content/**, and labels naming external products (e.g. Google Calendar). A terminology finding is never merge-blocking.
